notes: Candidates: no severity 2 or 3 developing event and no severity 3 event older than 3 days was left unchecked by the follow-up runs of the last 24 hours; picked single_source events of listed companies and one claim against a large company. Soft99 date moved from 20 Nov (Security NEXT) to 10 Nov (Soft99's own notice) with a correction. GTA 6 claim dated 19 Nov from VGC, still claimed, severity 1. PLUS: the 32,479 total (not in PLUS's notice) was removed and per-service counts added from the notice. MeetsMore: company name corrected from 'Mitsumo'. soft99 keeps a figure-qualifier warning: the evidence quote says 最大136,968人 (最大 = 'up to'), which the checker does not read as 'up to'. plus keeps the roundup-source warning for PLAID's own notice, which is the vendor notice of the parent breach, not a roundup.
